block.name: base
block.label: Base phase, 22 weeks to race. Long run holding around 12 km while you build aerobic volume before the specific work.

days.purpose: Build lower body strength and support running economy with squat and hinge patterns.
Active recovery and maintain aerobic base without adding fatigue before squash.

days.session_type: Full Body Strength - Push Focus (Bench Priority)
days.purpose: Maintain upper body strength with a focus on bench press, support overall athleticism.

days.session_type: Quality Run - Easy with Optional Marathon Pace Segment

run.pace: 10 min Easy (5:35-6:00/km, HR <150), then 40 min General Aerobic (5:25-5:45/km, HR 150-160) with 3-4 x 5 min at Marathon Pace (4:51/km, HR 165-170) embedded, 10 min Easy cool-down.
run.effort: Controlled quality, focus on hitting MP segments precisely.

days.purpose: Introduce marathon pace work to build specific endurance and efficiency.
Develop posterior chain strength and core stability, crucial for running power and injury prevention.

days.details: Full 40 min mobility session: deep squat hold 2 min, pigeon pose 90s/side, thread-the-needle 10/side, side lunge stretch 60s/side, ankle dorsiflexion mobilisation 2 min, supine hip flexor stretch 90s/side. Optional: 10 min foam roll (quads, IT band, upper back).
days.purpose: Promote recovery, improve flexibility, and address specific mobility restrictions to prevent injury.

run.effort: General aerobic, conversational but sustained. Focus on consistent HR.

days.purpose: Build aerobic endurance and time on feet, crucial for marathon performance.

hard_rules: If labour starts, stop. No 'one last session.'
Easy means easy — HR <150 on easy runs.
Sleep is the override: <6h = drop to a walk or skip.
